## Notes

- `openspec archive` refused to empty `context-engine` and `session-bootstrap`. The change file got `retire_capabilities: true`, so archive deleted both main specs. No empty shell was left.

- spec-ctx exempts an ID that an active REMOVED block names from `uncovered` and `scenario-untested`. So strict passes while the 17 removals wait for archive.
- spec-ctx is private for now. CI checks that it can read the repository. Without access the `specs-skipped` job prints the skip line and passes. `scripts/ci-local.sh` before each push is the primary gate.
- Tasks 1.1 and 3.1 ran twice. Their tagged tests changed in 3.3, `check --strict` reported stale evidence, and `specctx task reopen` kept the old evidence.
- The five governance tests that run the engine skip when `scripts/ci-reach.sh` cannot read the engine repository. On this machine they run, and `scripts/ci-local.sh` runs them before each push.
